description:
At PDI Technologies, we empower some of the world's leading convenience retail and petroleum brands with cutting-edge technology solutions that drive growth and operational efficiency. By “Connecting Convenience” across the globe, we empower businesses to increase productivity, make more informed decisions, and engage faster with customers through loyalty programs, shopper insights, and unmatched real-time market intelligence via mobile applications, such as GasBuddy.  We’re a global team committed to excellence, collaboration, and driving real impact. Explore our opportunities and become part of a company that values diversity, integrity, and growth.

About the Role

We’re looking for an experienced Software Engineer IV to help build, scale, and operate our multi-tenant cloud platform on AWS. This platform provides shared APIs, data pipelines, and identity services that support products across PDI.

You’ll work in a modern TypeScript/Node.js environment that includes containerized services and serverless functions, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, and an S3/Parquet data lake. This is a hands-on senior engineering role for someone who is comfortable diving into an existing codebase, solving complex back-end challenges, and owning solutions from initial design through production.

You’ll also play an important role in modernizing legacy technology, including helping migrate SQL Server and .NET workloads to our cloud platform.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, test, and deploy scalable back-end services and platform capabilities using TypeScript, Node.js, and AWS.
  • Build and maintain multi-tenant APIs and event-driven services using technologies such as REST, MQTT, SQS, and SNS.
  • Develop solutions with strong tenant isolation, authentication, and security using OAuth 2.0, OIDC, and JWT.
  • Research, troubleshoot, and resolve software issues across services, data pipelines, and infrastructure.
  • Monitor application and platform performance through logs, metrics, and traces, proactively identifying opportunities to improve reliability and availability.
  • Partner with Product and Support teams to troubleshoot issues, prioritize enhancements, and improve the customer experience.
  • Provide senior-level technical input during design discussions and help shape solutions for complex system changes and enhancements.
  • Identify opportunities to improve system performance, scalability, security, and supportability.
  • Help modernize legacy technology by migrating SQL Server stored procedures and .NET services to cloud-native solutions.
  • Contribute to infrastructure as code, container builds, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Write automated unit and integration tests and participate in peer code reviews to maintain high standards for quality and security.
  • Help reduce technical debt and continuously improve engineering practices and operational efficiency.
  • Participate in the team's on-call rotation and incident response.
  • Share ideas, influence technical decisions, and contribute to the continued evolution of the platform.

    • What You'll Bring

  • 6+ years of professional software development experience, including at least 4 years developing and maintaining back-end services using TypeScript/Node.js.
  • 4+ years building high-availability, high-volume distributed services on AWS, using technologies such as Lambda, ECS/EKS, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, SQS, and Cognito.
  • Strong proficiency with TypeScript, Node.js, SQL, and PostgreSQL.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes and CI/CD tools such as Jenkins or similar platforms.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code using Terraform, OpenTofu, or similar technologies.
  • Strong understanding of application and cloud security, including OAuth 2.0/OIDC, JWT, least-privilege IAM, secrets management, and multi-tenant data isolation.
  • Experience serving as a technical lead or senior developer on medium- to large-scale projects, with the ability to help drive design, development, and implementation.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to diagnose complex production issues.
  • Ability to evaluate system needs and recommend solutions that improve performance, scalability, reliability, and supportability.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills and the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and take ownership in a fast-paced environment.
  • A collaborative mindset and willingness to dig into unfamiliar technology, ask questions, and learn quickly.
  • Ability to influence technical decisions and build alignment without relying on direct authority.
  • Experience effectively using AI-assisted development tools while maintaining appropriate engineering, security, and code-quality standards.

    • Nice to Have

  • Experience with C#/.NET or SQL Server, particularly in environments undergoing cloud modernization.
  • Experience with data pipelines and analytical data technologies such as Parquet, DuckDB, Iceberg, or change data capture (CDC).
  • Experience modernizing or migrating legacy on-premises applications to AWS.
    • PDI is committed to offering a well-rounded benefits program, designed to support and care for you, and your family throughout your life and career.  This includes a competitive salary, market-competitive benefits, and a quarterly perks program. We encourage a good work-life balance with ample time off [time away] and, where appropriate, hybrid working arrangements.  Employees have access to continuous learning, professional certifications, and leadership development opportunities. Our global culture fosters diversity, inclusion, and values authenticity, trust, curiosity, and diversity of thought, ensuring a supportive environment for all.
